title: Hoe Scythes
description: Server-side NeoForge 1.21.1 mod that lets hoes clear grass-like blocks in 3x3 to 9x9 areas.
body: # Hoe Scythes **Hoe Scythes** adds a simple, server-side quality-of-life feature for clearing grass, ferns, and seagrass without replacing vanilla hoes or adding new tools. When you break a supported grass-like block with a hoe, the mod clears nearby matching blocks in a square area. The clearing radius depends on the hoe material, so better hoes cover more ground by default. ## Hoe Tiers - **Wooden Hoe and Stone Hoe:** 3x3 area - **Iron Hoe and Golden Hoe:** 5x5 area - **Diamond Hoe:** 7x7 area - **Netherite Hoe:** 9x9 area ## Supported Blocks By default, hoes affect: - Short grass - Tall grass - Ferns - Large ferns - Seagrass - Tall seagrass ## Config Hoe Scythes creates a common config file at config/hoescythes-common.toml. You can change: - The radius for each supported hoe type - The list of block IDs hoes can clear The default radii preserve the normal areas: - Radius 1 = 3x3 - Radius 2 = 5x5 - Radius 3 = 7x7 - Radius 4 = 9x9 Add blocks to clearableBlocks to support more plants, such as flowers. For example, add minecraft:poppy if you want hoes to clear poppies too. ## How It Works Break a supported block while holding one of the supported hoes in your main hand. The mod clears the surrounding grass-like blocks around the broken block and drops items normally where applicable. ### Example Using a **Diamond Hoe** on grass clears a 7x7 area centered on the block you broke.
